---
name: review-learning-change
description: Review a bounded classroom change using implementation evidence.
agent: ask
---

Review the attached file or proposed change for a learner repository.

1. Explain the intended behavior from the implementation.
2. Identify one concrete correctness, security, or usability issue, if supported by evidence.
3. Propose the smallest useful change and explain why it is needed.
4. Define an observable success check and a meaningful failure case.
5. Name any behavior you could not verify.

Preserve public interfaces and file formats unless the user explicitly requests a change. Do not invent findings to fill the checklist. Cite relevant files and primary documentation for product/API claims.
